context.body: Gentile readers are described as formerly alienated from Israel and strangers to covenants of promise, then brought near by Christ’s blood.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Plural covenant memory appears inside a movement from distance to nearness and from divided groups toward peace.
observations.label: Strangers to the covenants of promise: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps Far off → brought near visible within its covenant claim.
observations.label: Strangers to the covenants of promise: action, promise, or consequence

observations.body: Gentiles · Israel · both groups · Covenants of promise · Blood of Christ · Far off → brought near
observations.label: Relationships named in Ephesians 2:11–18

payload.posture: Read Ephesians 2:11–18 as its own covenants remembered covenant setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: The source places Far off → brought near inside this covenant setting without turning it into a definition for every covenant passage.
payload.title: Strangers to the covenants of promise
